code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and low lymphocyte and neutrophil percentages, suggesting possible bone marrow suppression or systemic inflammation. Elevated CRP, ferritin, INR, and D-dimer indicate significant inflammation and possible coagulopathy. Mildly low calcium and protein are noted. These findings are concerning for severe infection (possibly sepsis), hypoxic respiratory failure, and a risk of bleeding; urgent clinical evaluation is recommended.
